tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs rnams nor lha dang bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa'i bu yug 'tshub pa tsam bzhugs par bsams la/ ngag tu/ bla ma dkon mchog khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang bar chad ma lus pa/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs la/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan du yid ches pa'i/ blo lhings khel gyi gsol ba btab na/ bar chad thams cad rang zhir 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /yang smras pa/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /bstan 'dzin ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen sogs kyis gtsos pa'i rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sogs/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /bdag cag rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don thams cad 'grub ste bstan pa rgyas pa dang / phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can du skye ba ste/ thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bzhi thog yang rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge'i 'du byed don grub bkra shis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //chos skyong rnams kyi bskang bshag 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma dang bstan srung 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ sa skya'i bstan srung dbang po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang 'dis/ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyes ltung ma lus bshags/ /bstan dgra ma lus da lta bsgral ba dang / /bdag cag dpon slob don tshe ring nad med don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa'i kun 'grub par mdzod/

/ces chos skyong rnams kyi bskang bshag 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bstan srung khyad par can rnams la dam tshig dang ldan pa'i dpon slob nyung bsdus res kyis bskang bshag brgya tshar bgyi ba la bsams nas dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du mahā ka la'i bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i ngang nas sbyar ba 'dis/ bdag cag dpon slob kyi don thams cad yid bzhin du 'bad med lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /sarba dā oṃ// ༈ //bka' srung rnams kyi bskang bshag don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru mahā kā la ya/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma mahā kā la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ rgyud gsum dregs pa kun 'dus srid zhi'i bdag /sa skya'i bstan srung dbang po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang 'dis/ /thugs dam bskangs shing nyes ltung ma lus bshags/ /las dang 'phral rkyen bar chad kun bzlogs nas/ /bstan dgra ma lus da lta bsgral ba dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag khyed bstod kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bka' srung rnams la bskang bshag bzlog bskul bstod pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad nyung ngu 'di lcags mo sbrul lo gtsang phyogs su bod sog 'thab pa'i dus ngan gyi 'khrug long chen po byung dus/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams a nan+da puṇ+ya/ kyis lhag bsam dag pas sems can bde thabs kyi rgyal po phan tshun 'dun chings kyi don la dpal e waṃ chos ldan du 'byor pa'i tshe/ sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la yid ches kyi dad pa rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub bo/ /'dis kyang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/sa dhū/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
